meta.title: Demonology Ghosts

sources.label: Demonology Wiki (Fandom) - Ghosts/Types (in-game journal entries, V1.10.0)

sourceNotes: Roster, evidence sets, and traits are locked to the canonical Demonology Fandom wiki, which mirrors the in-game journal at update V1.10.0 (the live game place is 18199615050). The Ghosts/Types page states 'There are currently 25 ghost types in-game' and lists exactly 25 in the GhostNav template. This resolves the research-stage count conflict (16 / 23 / 24): 25 is the locked count.

demonology.wiki (standalone, 23 ghosts) was missing Ravager and Vesper, which is why secondary sources undercounted. Pro Game Guides (16) predates the Wither evidence rebalance and was not used for evidence sets or counts.

Evidence-type LABELS use the current canonical Evidence page wording: the eight types are EMF Level 5, Prints (formerly 'Handprints'), Spirit Box, Ghost Orb, Freezing Temperatures, Inscription (formerly 'Ghost Writing'), Laser Projector, and Wither. The Evidence page has adopted 'Prints' and 'Inscription'; the older Ghosts/Types template still shows the legacy 'Handprints'/'Ghost Writing' anchors, but per the single-most-current-source rule the Evidence page labels are used. Legacy names are kept in evidenceAltNames for reference, not rendered.

Section grouping is by mechanic: 'Wither Ghosts' = the 8 ghosts whose evidence set includes Wither (Aswang, Dullahan, Dybbuk, Keres, Siren, The Wisp, Vesper, Vex); 'Core Ghosts' = the remaining 17. Wither is the newest evidence type and the biggest source of identification confusion, so separating it helps readers scan to the relevant block.

Per-ghost evidence and traits are transcribed directly from each journal entry on Ghosts/Types and are sourceConfidence 'high'. Where two-or-three journal traits exist, behavior text summarizes them; no traits were invented.

Images are deferred to the image gate and are null at this stage; each ghost has an in-game journal portrait (drawn by @Windaroon) plus a 3D Ghost Model. The image gate will source/capture one portrait per ghost. Images are NOT a data blocker.
Evergreen-safe: no dates, no 'current/latest', no active-count-as-freshness wording in any rendered prose field. The update version is recorded only in this hidden source note for provenance.
meta.imageStatus: deferred to image gate; null at this stage

items.name: Spirit
items.cardSummary: A baseline ghost with no special speed or hunting quirks, identified by its Inscription, Prints, and Spirit Box evidence.
items.huntBehavior: Behaves like a standard ghost with no movement or hunting bonuses
items.weaknessTip: Has no unusual resistances, so normal hiding and looping work well
items.idTip: Can turn lit candles blue, a small tell unique to it
items.verificationNote: Evidence (Inscription/Prints/Spirit Box) and the blue-candle trait taken from the Spirit journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0).

items.name: Demon
items.cardSummary: An aggressive ghost that hunts far more often than others, leaving EMF Level 5, Freezing Temperatures, and Prints.
items.huntBehavior: Hunts frequently, so expect earlier and more repeated hunts
items.weaknessTip: The Cross has a larger range against it and makes it float as it burns
items.idTip: Unusually frequent hunts paired with its evidence set point to a Demon
items.verificationNote: Evidence and frequent-hunt / Cross-range traits taken from the Demon journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0).

items.name: Banshee
items.cardSummary: A glass-breaking ghost identified by Freezing Temperatures, Ghost Orb, and Prints, sometimes announced by a unique wail.
items.huntBehavior: Can break multiple windows and mirrors at once and may let out a unique wail at the start of a hunt
items.weaknessTip: Standard hiding works; listen for its distinctive hunt scream
items.idTip: A unique wail at hunt start, plus shattered glass, signals a Banshee
items.verificationNote: Evidence and window/mirror + wail traits taken from the Banshee journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0).

items.name: Entity
items.cardSummary: A teleporting ghost identified by Prints, Laser Projector, and Spirit Box, marked by smoke when it moves objects.
items.huntBehavior: Teleports between rooms and can teleport objects, shown by a smoke effect
items.weaknessTip: Hard to track by location; rely on evidence rather than chasing it room to room
items.idTip: Sudden teleports between rooms and smoke-marked object moves point to an Entity
items.verificationNote: Evidence and teleport / smoke traits taken from the Entity journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0).

items.name: Ghoul
items.cardSummary: A chat-triggered ghost identified by Freezing Temperatures, Ghost Orb, and Spirit Box that cannot disable electronics.
items.evidence: Freezing Temperatures, Ghost Orb, Spirit Box
items.huntBehavior: Excessive chat messages can trigger its hunt, and it cannot disable electronics
items.weaknessTip: Keep chat use limited; its inability to cut electronics keeps your gear working during hunts
items.idTip: Electronics staying on during a hunt, plus chat-triggered hunts, identify a Ghoul
items.verificationNote: Evidence and chat-trigger / no-electronics-disable traits taken from the Ghoul journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0).

items.name: Leviathan
items.cardSummary: A power-meddling ghost identified by Inscription, Prints, and Ghost Orb that flickers gear and kills lights.
items.huntBehavior: Can flicker equipment and passively turns off lights
items.weaknessTip: Expect unreliable gear and dark rooms; keep a light source handy
items.idTip: Equipment flickering and lights going out on their own suggest a Leviathan
items.verificationNote: Evidence and flicker / passive-lights-off traits taken from the Leviathan journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0).

items.name: Nightmare
items.cardSummary: A light-fearing ghost identified by EMF Level 5, Ghost Orb, and Spirit Box that can fake sounds.
items.evidence: EMF Level 5, Ghost Orb, Spirit Box
items.huntBehavior: Can cause auditory hallucinations and is afraid of lit rooms
items.weaknessTip: Keep lights on, since it avoids lit rooms
items.idTip: Phantom sounds plus a clear preference for dark rooms point to a Nightmare
items.verificationNote: Evidence and hallucination / fears-light traits taken from the Nightmare journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0).

items.name: Oni
items.cardSummary: A fast hunter identified by Freezing Temperatures, Laser Projector, and Spirit Box that shows itself often.
items.evidence: Freezing Temperatures, Laser Projector, Spirit Box
items.huntBehavior: Extremely fast during hunts and more likely to start ghost events and appear
items.weaknessTip: Looping is risky because of its hunt speed; favor closets and lockers
items.idTip: Very fast hunts and frequent visible appearances identify an Oni
items.verificationNote: Evidence and hunt-speed / frequent-event traits taken from the Oni journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0). Listed among the ghosts with speed differences.

items.name: Phantom
items.cardSummary: A slow-blinking ghost identified by EMF Level 5, Prints, and Ghost Orb that speeds up while invisible.
items.huntBehavior: Blinks in and out more slowly but moves faster while invisible during hunts
items.weaknessTip: Track its slow blink pattern, but be ready for fast movement when it vanishes
items.idTip: Longer gaps between blinks during a hunt point to a Phantom
items.verificationNote: Evidence and slow-blink / faster-while-invisible traits taken from the Phantom journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0). Listed among the ghosts with speed differences.

items.name: Ravager
items.cardSummary: An object-hurling ghost identified by EMF Level 5, Inscription, and Spirit Box whose abilities all leave EMF Level 5.
items.huntBehavior: Can throw multiple objects, may start a vortex while hunting, and every ability leaves EMF Level 5
items.weaknessTip: Watch for thrown objects and the hunting vortex; keep distance from clutter
items.idTip: Multiple objects thrown at once, with EMF Level 5 on every ability, identify a Ravager
items.verificationNote: Ravager is a current roster ghost (was the renamed Poltergeist). Evidence and throw/vortex/EMF traits taken from the Ravager journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0).

items.name: Revenant
items.cardSummary: A relentless hunter identified by EMF Level 5, Freezing Temperatures, and Inscription that stops hunting after a kill.
items.huntBehavior: Has a low hunting cooldown but stops hunting once it kills a player
items.weaknessTip: Expect back-to-back hunts until it claims a victim, then a lull
items.idTip: Rapid, repeated hunts that pause after a kill point to a Revenant
items.verificationNote: Evidence and low-cooldown / stops-after-kill traits taken from the Revenant journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0).

items.name: Shadow
items.cardSummary: A light-shy ghost identified by EMF Level 5, Inscription, and Laser Projector with smaller temperature swings.
items.huntBehavior: Produces lower temperature changes and is less active in lit rooms
items.weaknessTip: Keep rooms lit to suppress its activity; freezing temps may be subtle
items.idTip: Weaker cold readings plus reduced activity in lit rooms suggest a Shadow
items.verificationNote: Evidence and low-temp / less-active-in-light traits taken from the Shadow journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0).

items.name: Skinwalker
items.cardSummary: A deceptive mimic identified by Freezing Temperatures, Inscription, and Spirit Box that fakes a Ghost Orb.
items.huntBehavior: Fakes a Ghost Orb that is not real evidence and can mimic other ghosts' abilities
items.weaknessTip: Do not trust a lone Ghost Orb here; confirm with its three true evidence types
items.idTip: A Ghost Orb that does not fit the rest of the evidence is the Skinwalker's fake
items.verificationNote: Evidence and fake-orb / mimic traits taken from the Skinwalker journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0). Note: the fake Ghost Orb still appears in the ghost room.

items.name: Specter
items.cardSummary: A room-bound ghost identified by EMF Level 5, Freezing Temperatures, and Laser Projector that throws items often.
items.evidence: EMF Level 5, Freezing Temperatures, Laser Projector
items.huntBehavior: Throws items frequently and stays in its ghost room except while hunting
items.weaknessTip: Its strong attachment to one room makes the ghost room easy to pin down
items.idTip: Frequent thrown items and a ghost that never roams point to a Specter
items.verificationNote: Evidence and frequent-throw / room-bound traits taken from the Specter journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0).

items.name: Umbra
items.cardSummary: A silent stalker identified by Prints, Ghost Orb, and Laser Projector that slows down in lit rooms.
items.huntBehavior: Makes no footstep sounds and moves slower in lit rooms
items.weaknessTip: Keep lights on to slow it, and do not rely on footsteps to locate it
items.idTip: A ghost you cannot hear walking, that slows under lights, is an Umbra
items.verificationNote: Evidence and no-footsteps / slow-in-light traits taken from the Umbra journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0).

items.name: Wendigo
items.cardSummary: A flame-shy ghost identified by Inscription, Ghost Orb, and Laser Projector that speeds up as energy drops.
items.huntBehavior: Less likely to hunt near lit flames and increases in speed as average energy decreases
items.weaknessTip: Keep candles or a lantern lit to discourage hunts and watch your team's energy
items.idTip: A ghost that avoids flames but speeds up as energy falls points to a Wendigo
items.verificationNote: Evidence and avoids-flames / energy-speed traits taken from the Wendigo journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0). Listed among the ghosts with speed differences.

items.name: Wraith
items.cardSummary: An energy-draining ghost identified by EMF Level 5, Laser Projector, and Spirit Box that ignores salt.
items.evidence: EMF Level 5, Laser Projector, Spirit Box
items.huntBehavior: Drains player energy rapidly, roughly 0.2 to 0.4 percent per second, and does not disturb salt
items.weaknessTip: Salt piles stay untouched, so use that as a confirming test
items.idTip: Fast energy loss with undisturbed salt identifies a Wraith
items.verificationNote: Evidence and energy-drain / ignores-salt traits taken from the Wraith journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0).

items.name: Aswang
items.cardSummary: A snowballing killer identified by EMF Level 5, Inscription, and Wither that gets faster with every kill.
items.huntBehavior: Speed increases every time it kills, so it becomes more dangerous as a match goes on
items.weaknessTip: Salt slows it down, making salt a key tool against it
items.idTip: A ghost that visibly speeds up after each kill points to an Aswang
items.verificationNote: Evidence and speed-on-kill / salt-slow traits taken from the Aswang journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0). Listed among the ghosts with speed differences.

items.name: Dullahan
items.cardSummary: A headless hunter identified by Freezing Temperatures, Laser Projector, and Wither that appears headless in photos.
items.huntBehavior: Increases in speed the longer a player stays in its line of sight
items.weaknessTip: Break line of sight quickly to keep it from accelerating
items.idTip: A headless figure in Photo Camera shots confirms a Dullahan
items.verificationNote: Evidence and headless-photo / line-of-sight-speed traits taken from the Dullahan journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0). Listed among the ghosts with speed differences.

items.name: Dybbuk
items.cardSummary: A corpse-throwing ghost identified by Freezing Temperatures, Prints, and Wither that the music box stuns.
items.huntBehavior: Can throw corpses around the site as a hunting hazard
items.weaknessTip: It is stunned the first time the music box is played, a useful counter
items.idTip: Being stunned by the first music box play points to a Dybbuk
items.verificationNote: Evidence and music-box-stun / throws-corpses traits taken from the Dybbuk journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0).

items.name: Keres
items.cardSummary: A low-energy hunter identified by Prints, Spirit Box, and Wither that slows down with each kill.
items.huntBehavior: Speed decreases every time it kills and it targets the hunter with the least energy
items.weaknessTip: Keep your energy topped up, since it chases whoever is lowest; in solo it targets you below 90 percent energy
items.idTip: A ghost that locks onto your lowest-energy teammate identifies a Keres
items.verificationNote: Evidence and slow-on-kill / low-energy-targeting traits taken from the Keres journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0). Listed among the ghosts with speed differences.

items.name: Siren
items.cardSummary: A singing ghost identified by EMF Level 5, Spirit Box, and Wither that slows anyone in its line of sight.
items.huntBehavior: Uses a female model and voice, slows anyone within line of sight, and can hum in the Spirit Box instead of answering
items.weaknessTip: Avoid staying in its sightline during hunts to dodge the slow effect
items.idTip: A humming Spirit Box response and a slowing effect on nearby players point to a Siren
items.verificationNote: Evidence and humming / line-of-sight-slow traits taken from the Siren journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0).

items.name: The Wisp
items.cardSummary: A fire-walking ghost identified by Laser Projector, Ghost Orb, and Wither that only hunts from its favorite room.
items.huntBehavior: Can walk through lines of fire, can light candles, and only starts a hunt when a player is in its favorite room
items.weaknessTip: Stay out of its ghost room to deny it the ability to hunt
items.idTip: A ghost that can only hunt while you are in its room confirms The Wisp
items.verificationNote: Evidence and fire-walk / room-locked-hunt traits taken from The Wisp journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0). Name is 'The Wisp' in-game.

items.name: Vesper
items.cardSummary: A sound-driven ghost identified by Inscription, Prints, and Wither that hears through walls.
items.huntBehavior: Relies solely on sound and can hear through walls
items.weaknessTip: Stay quiet, crouch, and avoid sprinting near it to lower your noise
items.idTip: A ghost that finds you through walls by sound points to a Vesper
items.verificationNote: Vesper is a current roster ghost missing from older 23-ghost lists. Evidence and sound-only / hears-through-walls traits taken from the Vesper journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0).

items.name: Vex
items.cardSummary: A wall-phasing ghost identified by Freezing Temperatures, Ghost Orb, and Wither that hides from the LIDAR Scanner.
items.huntBehavior: Does not show up in LIDAR scans and can walk through walls
items.weaknessTip: Looping is unreliable since it can phase through walls; favor closets and lockers
items.idTip: A ghost that never appears on the LIDAR Scanner points to a Vex
items.verificationNote: Evidence and no-LIDAR / wall-walk traits taken from the Vex journal entry on Ghosts/Types (V1.10.0).
